work.title: Desktop Dump Archive
txt: No one knows what's on your computer; all those files you consider private are probably jumbled together in a messy folder.
Since 2020, she has occasionally posted the contents of her desktop online to give us a glimpse into her digital private life
She draws inspiration from her experience of web culture to produce a wide variety of works, including photography, performances, installations and websites, to name but a few.

Author.title: Molly Soda
txt: Molly Soda, whose real name is “Amalia Soto,” is a New Yorker who was born in San Juan, Puerto Rico, in 1989.
She draws inspiration from her experience with web culture to create a wide variety of works, including photography, performances, installations, and websites—to name just a few.

otherWorks.title: + Works
txt: In her creative process, Molly Soda draws a great deal of inspiration from her experiences on the internet and social media.

She likes to use things that are generally considered private, shameful, undesirable, or trivial. Presenting archival material of herself and performing “mundane” situations is a recurring feature of her art.

artisticMovement.title: Net Art
txt: Internet art is a form of new media art distributed via the Internet that bypasses the traditional dominance of galleries and museums.

It is often interactive, participatory, and multimedia-based. It can be used to convey a political or social message. It does not refer to art that has simply been digitized and posted online: the work is intrinsically dependent on the network.
